WITH media_rates AS (
  SELECT
    mt.MediaTypeId,
    mt.Name,
    AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM MediaType AS mt
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
)
SELECT
  Name,
  bytes_per_millisecond,
  bytes_per_millisecond / AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) OVER () AS relative_to_average
FROM media_rates;

assumptions.assumption: For each media type, its figure is the simple average of each matching track's Bytes divided by Milliseconds; the comparison average counts each media type's resulting figure once.
